option_relations.rationale: Catastrophic Adult-onset Still Disease (AOSD) is a severe form or subtype of Adult-onset Still's disease. Secondary hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis/macrophage activation syndrome (MAS) is a known complication of AOSD.
